decisions.reason: The formwork profile line is close to the core offer, cheap to hold, and has no evidence against it, so the option stays open while demand for precast formwork keeps growing.
The automated distributor flow control is embedded in the firm's automation systems and supports its strategic direction, so its upside justifies the low holding cost.
Shuttering magnets are a low-cost recurring accessory adjacent to the core business, and with no negative signal, abandoning them would destroy option value for little gain.
The magnetic formwork strips have their own page and several models, which signals commitment, and they cost little to maintain.
The component sits close to the established magnetic formwork offer with its own presence, so keeping it remains cheap while its value is still resolving.
Overlap with other magnetic components makes F the likeliest candidate for consolidation, but its holding cost is minimal and the evidence does not yet justify abandoning it.
